title: polystichum lanuginosum
intro: Polystichum lanuginosum, commonly known as the woolly fern, is a species of flowering plant in the family Dryopteridaceae. As a traditional medicinal plant, the woolly fern has been used to treat various health issues, including fever, rheumatism, and respiratory problems, due to its health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Polystichum lanuginosum include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiviral effects, making it a valuable remedy for various conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
